random_method: Python random.Random(seed), one choice per ordered setting/event/lighting list authored from general knowledge

setting: a volcanic cove beneath a sea cave arch
event: retrieving a floating surfboard after a small broken wave
pausing with one hand on a surfboard while shore foam streams past her ankles
stepping from a low rock ledge toward a floating paddleboard
lighting: late afternoon side light beneath storm clouds
cool overcast with a narrow sunbreak

selected.event: retrieving a floating surfboard after a small broken wave
selected.lighting: cool overcast with a narrow sunbreak

focal_choices_origin: agent_authored_under_requester_delegation; no exact garment structure specified in user text

gates.criterion: An adult subject retains recognizable facial proportions, dark eyes, and long dark hair from the portrait.
Fitted long sleeves, high crew neckline and both raglan construction and pale side panels are visually readable.
Separate overlapping shirt hem and swim briefs are discernible; both curved high-cut leg openings are readable.
Surfboard floats beside subject with visible rail/nose and one hand visibly contacting rail.
Wave or foam divides around legs and a curved white trail is visible in shallow water.
Selected setting and selected light are recognizable; droplets visibly catch light against darker space.
Visible hands, arms, legs, face and board interaction have no material anatomical or contact defect.

verdict_policy: All required gates must PASS; partial, unclear, obscured, or unevaluated is not PASS. Prompt and runtime audits are separate from pixels. One render only; preserve original even on failure.
candidate_data_effect_policy: Record exposed new swimwear candidate IDs and actual selected/adopted evidence separately. Rendering the independently authored baseline alone does not prove data contribution.
